title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models enable agents to optimize RTL using EDA feedback, yet their executable search procedures remain largely hand- engineered. We present Meta-RTL, an EDA-grounded framework that evolves RTL optimization harnesses from a minimal loop while keeping the optimization model, EDA flow, and per-design budgets fixed. Compared with Dr. RTL, Meta-RTL* reduces aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 7.8%/11.0% across 20 development designs, with area reductions on 70% of them. Without further evolution, Meta-RTL* transfers to 10 unseen IC-RTL designs, reducing aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 20.5%/14.0% and total synthesized area by 12.6%. We further characterize three search mechanisms in the evolved harness and assess their contributions through ablations and a case study.

translated_title: Meta-RTL：面向RTL优化的智能体执行框架进化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型使智能体能够利用EDA反馈来优化RTL（寄存器传输级）电路，但其可执行的搜索过程在很大程度上仍依赖人工设计。我们提出Meta-RTL，这是一个以EDA为基础的框架，它从一个极简循环出发自动进化出RTL优化执行框架，同时保持优化模型、EDA流程和每个设计的预算固定不变。与Dr. RTL相比，Meta-RTL*在20个开发设计上将总体WNS/TNS违例分别降低了7.8%/11.0%，并在其中70%的设计上实现了面积缩减。在无需进一步进化的情况下，Meta-RTL*可直接迁移至10个未见的IC-RTL设计，将总体WNS/TNS违例分别降低20.5%/14.0%，并将综合总面积降低12.6%。我们进一步刻画了进化后的执行框架中的三种搜索机制，并通过消融实验和案例研究评估了它们各自的贡献。
tldr: Meta-RTL提出了一种基于EDA反馈的自动进化框架，能从极简循环出发自动生成RTL优化智能体的执行框架，摆脱人工设计搜索过程的束缚，在时序违例和面积优化上显著优于现有方法，并可直接迁移到未见设计。
en_tdlr: Meta-RTL is an EDA-grounded framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for RTL optimization from a minimal loop, eliminating hand-engineered search procedures and achieving significant reductions in timing violations and area across both seen and unseen designs.
